race.description: Dabble - You Better Believe It Hcp (70)
race.comment: Competitive race but seasoned galloper VILLA SEVENTYNINE (9) should be ready to fire. Well travelled but returns to Darwin where he boasts a great record. Fitter for two runs back and extra trip a plus. Could be value but sure to be ready to fire now. GARRIX (11) is going great guns and will be well fancied. Placed in the Derby two back then placed behind Biden Time last time, who is engaged earlier in the day. In top form and expected to go close. BOLLON (4) is another going well. Two length winner here leading throughout over the mile last time and although yet to win over this trip will be in to for a long way. CRAZY TOWN (3) is coming off a placing in the NT Derby so is not to be underestimated. TENNESSEE WHISKEY (8) has a tricky gate but will give a sight.
